title: Comparative Characterization of KV Cache Management Strategies for LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2604.05012v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Efficient inference with Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly relies on Key-Value (KV) caches to store previously computed key and value vectors at each layer. These caches are essential to minimize redundant computation during autoregressive token generation, lowering computational complexity from quadratic to linear. However, the growth of KV caches has posed significant system-level challenges, particularly as model sizes increase, context lengths grow, and concurrent requests compete for limited memory resources. Even though several recent frameworks for KV cache management have emerged, their comparative trade-offs in memory consumption and inference performance have not been fully understood, especially under varying request sizes and model configurations. translated_title: 面向大语言模型推理的KV缓存管理策略的对比性分析
translated_abstract: 高效的大语言模型（LLM）推理日益依赖于键值（KV）缓存来存储每一层先前计算得到的键和值向量。这些缓存对于减少自回归token生成过程中的冗余计算至关重要，可将计算复杂度从二次方降低至线性。然而，KV缓存的不断增长带来了显著的系统级挑战，尤其是在模型规模增大、上下文长度增长以及并发请求争夺有限内存资源的情况下。尽管近期涌现出多个KV缓存管理框架，但它们在内存消耗和推理性能方面的比较权衡尚未被充分理解，特别是在不同请求规模和模型配置下。在本工作中，我们对三种最先进的KV缓存管理框架进行了实证研究：vLLM、InfiniGen和H2O。这些框架采用的技术……
tldr: 本文对vLLM、InfiniGen和H2O三种最先进的KV缓存管理框架进行了实证对比研究，系统分析了它们在不同请求规模和模型配置下于内存消耗与推理性能之间的权衡取舍。
